Brand.description: Look of the site. Every field is optional.

accent.description: Accent colour for links and actions, as a CSS colour (e.g. "#6B3FA0").

accent_dark.description: Accent colour used in dark mode; defaults to a lightened accent.

fonts_url.description: A Google Fonts (or other) stylesheet URL loading the fonts named below.

mark.description: One or two characters shown in the header's brand mark.

serif_font.description: CSS font-family for definitions and ledes.

Brand.title: Brand

KindNamespace.description: Where one kind of object is minted and how its ids are written, keyed by kind (e.g. `organization: {iri_segment: offices, authoring_prefix: office}`). Either field may be left out to keep its default.

authoring_prefix.description: The prefix this kind's ids are written with (may change at any time).

iri_segment.description: The path segment after iri_base for this kind's IRIs (permanent once published).

KindNamespace.title: KindNamespace

KindNamespace__identifier_optional.description: Where one kind of object is minted and how its ids are written, keyed by kind (e.g. `organization: {iri_segment: offices, authoring_prefix: office}`). Either field may be left out to keep its default.

authoring_prefix.description: The prefix this kind's ids are written with (may change at any time).

iri_segment.description: The path segment after iri_base for this kind's IRIs (permanent once published).

KindNamespace__identifier_optional.title: KindNamespace

PageSetting.description: Settings for one page, keyed by the IRI or CURIE of what it is about.

accent.description: Accent colour for links and actions, as a CSS colour (e.g. "#6B3FA0").

PageSetting.title: PageSetting

PageSetting__identifier_optional.description: Settings for one page, keyed by the IRI or CURIE of what it is about.

accent.description: Accent colour for links and actions, as a CSS colour (e.g. "#6B3FA0").

PageSetting__identifier_optional.title: PageSetting

Paths.description: Where things live, relative to dgo-atlas.yaml.

data.description: Directory of governance YAML files (searched recursively).

output.description: Directory the site is built into. Emptied on every build.

Paths.title: Paths

Prefix.description: A prefix ids or semantic types may use, written as `prefix: namespace` (e.g. `bfo: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_`).
Prefix.title: Prefix

Prefix__identifier_optional.description: A prefix ids or semantic types may use, written as `prefix: namespace` (e.g. `bfo: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_`).
Prefix__identifier_optional.title: Prefix

Repository.description: The implementer's source repository, for "view source" links. Omit it and the links are left off.
Repository.title: Repository

base_path.description: Where the site is served from: "/" for a custom domain, "/<repo>/" for a GitHub Pages project site. Only the 404 page uses it.

contact_email.description: Where readers report a problem with a definition.

description.description: One sentence describing the site, used on the landing page and in search results.

dgo_source.description: Import DGO from here instead of the release URL: a URL, or a path relative to dgo-atlas.yaml, to a single-file DGO schema (for a mirror, a fork, or offline builds). dgo_version still names the release.

dgo_version.description: The Data Governance Ontology release to use, as its tag (e.g. "0.1.0"). Its schema is imported from the DGO repository's dist/dgo.yaml at that tag. Quote it, or YAML may read it as a number.

iri_base.description: The namespace every id is minted in: a base you control and will keep stable, such as a w3id.org redirect (e.g. https://w3id.org/acme/). Each kind of object gets its own namespace under it (see `namespaces`), and each page is published at its IRI's path under the site, so one redirect from this base to the site resolves every IRI. Never change it once IRIs are published.

language.description: The language the site is written in, as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "fr-CA"). Set it to match any `text:` translations, so screen readers pronounce the pages correctly.

namespaces.description: Each kind's namespace and authoring prefix: objects of a kind are minted at <iri_base><iri_segment>/<name> and written <authoring_prefix>:<name>. iri_segment is part of every IRI, so never change it (or override a default) once IRIs are published; authoring_prefix is only how ids are written and may change at any time.

organization.description: The organization the site belongs to, shown under the title.

anyOf.description: Accent colour for links and actions, as a CSS colour (e.g. "#6B3FA0").

pages.description: Per-page settings keyed by the IRI or CURIE the page is about.

prefixes.description: Extra prefixes, as `prefix: namespace`: those of the ontologies your semantic types come from, and any alias for one of your own namespaces. Each kind's authoring prefix is declared for you.

show_identifiers.description: Show the Identifier panel (id, expanded IRI, DGO class) on term, council, person and organization pages. Set false to hide it.

suggest_change_url.description: A URL that starts a change request. The term's CURIE is appended, URL encoded, so end it with a query parameter such as `&term=`.

text.description: Replacement wording for the site, keyed by text key (e.g. `term.history: Change log`). Run `dgo-atlas text` to list every key and its default.

title.description: The site's name, shown in the header and every page title.

TextOverride.description: Replacement wording for one text key, written as `key: wording` (e.g. `term.history: Change log`). `dgo-atlas text` lists the keys.
TextOverride.title: TextOverride

TextOverride__identifier_optional.description: Replacement wording for one text key, written as `key: wording` (e.g. `term.history: Change log`). `dgo-atlas text` lists the keys.
TextOverride__identifier_optional.title: TextOverride
